marketSummary: Indian equity benchmarks staged an aggressive relief rally on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, with the Nifty 50 reclaiming the 22,700 mark (+1.60% to 22,721.95) and the Sensex rocketing over 1,100 points to 73,033.78. The powerful upmove was spearheaded by a >5% surge in the Nifty IT index on the back of blockbuster Q2 numbers and record deal wins from HCLTech alongside post-earnings strength in TCS. Market sentiment was further boosted by cooling crude oil prices, a stabilizing rupee, and positive commentary from the Finance Ministry regarding capital gains and transaction taxes, prompting broad short-covering across financial services, consumer discretionary, and auto sectors.
dailyFocus: Trade high-momentum base breakouts in large-cap IT and tier-1 defence contractors displaying fresh order wins and capacity commitments. Keep tight trailing stops on retail counters where store expansion is diverging from operating margins, and monitor power transmission leaders testing cup-with-handle neckline pivots.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Bags Fresh Orders Worth ₹533 Crore Across Avionics and Defense Systems
news.summary: Navratna defence PSU Bharat Electronics Limited disclosed on October 13 that it secured incremental contracts worth ₹533 crore since its previous disclosure on September 17. The new order package encompasses communication systems, avionics suites, electronic jammers, drones, and cybersecurity solutions, maintaining steady inflows and reinforcing an aggregate order backlog approaching ₹76,000 crore.
news.impact: Provides immediate fundamental confirmation for swing positions consolidating near upper base boundaries, increasing odds of a clean resistance breakout.

news.headline: Nifty Reclaims 22,700 in 358-Point Surge Spurred by IT Rally and Calming Macro Headwinds
news.summary: The NSE Nifty 50 surged 1.60% to settle at 22,721.95, while the BSE Sensex rose 1,109 points to 73,033.78 on Tuesday, breaking a two-day slide. Buying was led by the Nifty IT index (+5%), aided by softening crude prices, government reassurances regarding capital gains taxation and STT stability, and domestic institutional inflows absorbing foreign portfolio rebalancing.
news.impact: Restores positive market breadth across swing watchlists, reducing false-breakout risk for setups clearing 20-day and 50-day moving average handles.

news.headline: DMart Slides to 52-Week Low After Q2 Margin Squeeze and Slower Store Productivity
news.summary: Avenue Supermarts reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹19,644 crore (+17.8% YoY) and net profit of ₹743 crore (+8.5% YoY), but saw EBITDA margins compress 20 bps to 7.1% and PAT margin shrink to 3.8% due to entry-level wage inflation and quick-commerce discounting. Annualized sales per square foot rose just 0.6% despite 19.6% retail footprint growth, sending the stock down nearly 5% over two sessions to fresh 52-week lows near ₹3,345.
news.impact: Triggers a confirmed breakdown below multi-month support to test long-term moving averages; invalidates bullish swing base setups until margin stability returns.

news.headline: HCLTech Q2 Net Profit Jumps 21.2% YoY to ₹5,132 Crore; Deal Bookings Hit Record $3.3 Billion
news.summary: HCL Technologies posted its highest-ever quarterly net profit of ₹5,132 crore for Q2 FY27, up 21.2% YoY, with revenue rising 11.5% to ₹35,620 crore. Operating EBIT margins widened 131 bps sequentially to 18.2%, while constant-currency advanced AI revenue jumped 78% YoY to $219 million. Management maintained full-year revenue growth guidance of 2.5%–4.0% and declared a second interim dividend of ₹12 per share with an October 16 record date.
news.impact: Catalyzed a high-volume Stage 2 base breakout (+8% intraday), confirming IT sector leadership and establishing a high-probability continuation pivot.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Outlines ₹6,000 Crore Expansion Across Kochi and VOC Port Units
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited has detailed plans for ~₹6,000 crore in strategic capex spanning two projects: a ₹3,000–₹4,000 crore steel-block fabrication facility at Vallarpadam in Kochi (leasing 78 acres) to resolve block throughput limits on its new 310-metre dry dock, and a dedicated shipbuilding/repair facility at VO Chidambaranar Port in Thoothukudi. This builds on subsidiary Hooghly-CSL's recent repeat order for two luxury river cruise vessels.
news.impact: Validates a multi-year execution ramp for large commercial/defense vessels, offering structural support to swing traders accumulating on low-volume pullbacks.

news.headline: Trent Extends Rally After Q2 Revenue Surges 23% and Zudio Crosses 1,000-Store Milestone
news.summary: Tata Group's retail heavyweight Trent reported standalone Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹5,788 crore, a 23% YoY jump that beat Street expectations. The company added 17 Zudio and 10 Westside stores on a net basis during the quarter, taking its network to 1,342 outlets and crossing the landmark 1,000th Zudio store mark. Top-tier brokerages reaffirmed bullish calls with targets ranging up to ₹3,406, powering continued follow-through gains on Tuesday (+2.6%).
news.impact: Exhibits classic high-relative-strength leadership, providing multi-week swing traders an active trend-continuation setup along rising short-term moving averages.

news.headline: CG Power Pulls Back Amid Global Semiconductor Infrastructure Volatility
news.summary: Shares of CG Power traded 1.5%–2.5% lower on Tuesday alongside peers Hitachi Energy and GE Vernova T&D, tracking an international pull-back across AI infrastructure and chip-related equipment suppliers. Despite short-term profit taking following its run past ₹910, the company's structural pipeline remains anchored by domestic transformer demand and its upcoming semiconductor OSAT facility.
news.impact: Indicates orderly healthy consolidation within a broader base; swing traders should wait for lower-range volume contraction before sizing new breakout entries.

news.headline: HAL Scales Engine Production with Expanded AL-31FP Output and New ₹218 Crore Shakti Line
news.summary: The Ministry of Defence announced that Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is accelerating aero-engine manufacturing, raising annual AL-31FP engine production capacity from 30 to 50 units for the IAF's Su-30MKI fleet. Concurrently, HAL is constructing a second ₹218-crore Shakti engine line at Koraput to manufacture up to 100 helicopter engines annually for Dhruv and Prachand platforms, alongside accelerated HTT-40 engine delivery timelines from Honeywell.
news.impact: Strengthens medium-term order book execution velocity, offering supportive price action inside its current multi-week consolidation base.

news.headline: KEC International Secures ₹1,014 Crore Domestic T&D Orders; YTD Inflow Crosses ₹9,600 Crore
news.summary: Infrastructure EPC major KEC International won fresh domestic orders worth ₹1,014 crore in its Transmission & Distribution division. The win includes the company's first-ever 765 kV transmission line project for evacuating renewable power from a Pumped Storage Plant in Western India, lifting year-to-date FY27 order intake past ₹9,600 crore.
news.impact: Reinforces an ascending cup-and-handle base pattern, presenting swing traders with an actionable high-volume breakout trigger above pivot resistance.

news.headline: TCS Rallies 6.5% as Post-Earnings Relief and Solid Deal Conversion Spark IT Sector Rebound
news.summary: Tata Consultancy Services shares gained 6.45% to ₹2,269 on Tuesday, pacing the IT index resurgence following its Q2 FY27 print (consolidated net profit up 15% YoY to ₹13,884 crore on revenue of ₹73,188 crore with ₹12 dividend). Investors focused on double-digit AI revenue contributions and sustained deal execution momentum after initial margin hesitation.
news.impact: Serves as the sector's anchor heavyweight, turning a multi-month rounding bottom into an active multi-day trend reversal.
